name: reload_mcp_servers
description: Reconciles the mcp.toml at the root of this session's folder (its project workspace, bot folder, or task folder) with the live shared MCP connections. Set global to true to reconcile {{happyPublicHome}}/config/mcp.toml instead. Unchanged connections keep running.

global.description: Reload the user-wide {{happyPublicHome}}/config/mcp.toml catalog instead of this folder's mcp.toml.
